draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.66, the 213th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 16th of 20 at DT. He went 184th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (213th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 sacks in 2019, 6th of 20 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 45 career games and 15 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 4 AV in 2020. Weak spots: pressures 0 (4th percentile), tackles for loss 0 (8th percentile).
